page.overview:
What is Mr. Moonlight?

Mr Moonlight is a song by Roy Lee Johnson. The Beatles covered this song on their 1964, Beatles for Sale

It was recorded on Friday August 14, and a remake was done on Sunday October 18. The master version is from takes 4 & 8.
